AdminReservationResponse.description: Any user's reservation as the Admin role sees it. Start and End are UTC (ADR-004).

AvailabilityResponse.description:
Free spaces of a lot for one interval. `start` and `end` are echoed with the
Europe/Sarajevo offset; `totalSpaces` counts active spaces.

CreateReservationRequest.description:
Body for creating a reservation: exactly one of SpaceId (that space) or LotId (the first free
space of the lot). Only the shape is checked here (400); the business rules R1–R14 stay in the domain (422).

CreateSpaceRequest.description: Body for adding a space. The label is trimmed and upper-cased, and must be unique in the lot.

LoginRequest.description: Body for signing in. No email format check: a wrong address simply gets the same 401.

LotRequest.description:
Body for creating or updating a lot. Only the shape is checked here (400); a non-positive price,
a bad currency or a window that closes before it opens are domain rules (422).

LotResponse.description: A parking lot. Opening hours are local Europe/Sarajevo times; totalSpaces counts active spaces.

PagedResultOfAdminReservationResponse.description: One page of items plus what a client needs to show the pager.

PagedResultOfLotResponse.description: One page of items plus what a client needs to show the pager.

PagedResultOfReservationResponse.description: One page of items plus what a client needs to show the pager.

QuoteResponse.description:
The price a reservation of the lot for this interval would get. `start` and `end` are
echoed with the Europe/Sarajevo offset; `billedHours` counts every started hour (R8).

RegisterRequest.description: Body for creating a customer account. Password strength is Identity's rule (422), not shape (400).

ReservationResponse.description: One of the caller's reservations. Start and End are UTC (ADR-004).

ReservationState.description: What a customer sees: ReservationStatus combined with the current time. Never stored.
